row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: ServiceTitan's SSO help page answers 'Is user provisioning via SCIM supported?' with 'Not yet. SCIM-based user provisioning and deprovisioning is planned for a future release later this year.'
row.notes: Status changed from unknown to none: ServiceTitan's help centre now states SCIM provisioning is not yet supported (planned for a later release) and users must be created in ServiceTitan before they can be linked to SSO. SSO is Microsoft Entra ID only and in Private Preview (enabled via the CSM); no plan gate is stated. Pricing is per technician with 'Request Pricing' on Starter, Essentials and The Works; June's ~$245-500/tech figures have no first-party source and are dropped. The Settings API (employees, technicians, user roles) is available to customer-built apps only on the Works or Ent Plus package.

limitations.text: SCIM provisioning and deprovisioning is planned for a future release; not available today.
Paths are shown relative to the Settings v2 API; the full base URL is not on the public endpoints page. What account-actions does (e.g. deactivate) is not described.

okta.notes: ServiceTitan says only Microsoft Entra ID is supported for SSO.

entra.notes: Tenant-level self-service SSO with Entra (Private Preview); users are linked to existing ServiceTitan accounts.

searched: https://help.servicetitan.com/llms.txt (sso, scim, provision, okta, entra, api)
open_questions: Which plans can use SSO (Private Preview, enabled via CSM) is not stated.
No public prices; June per-technician figures had no first-party source.
What the employees/technicians account-actions endpoint does (e.g. deactivate, reactivate) is not documented publicly.
Whether ServiceTitan has an Entra gallery or Okta OIN listing was not checked.
